name: AI Health OS Video Generator V1.0

nodes.name: When Executed by Another Workflow
nodes.notes: Entry point for AI Health OS Video Generator V1.0. Receives the complete Final Report JSON from an external caller without modifying the stable Master Orchestrator.

nodes.name: Parse Final Report
nodes.notes: Parses object, array, string, Markdown JSON, and common n8n wrapper inputs into one Final Report object.

nodes.name: Validate Input
nodes.notes: Validates successful Master status and required Agent 3–6 production fields before prompt generation.

nodes.name: Input Valid?
nodes.notes: TRUE continues to production extraction. FALSE stops safely and returns a structured validation error.

nodes.name: Build Validation Error
nodes.notes: Builds a structured parse/validation error; no prompts or files are generated.

nodes.name: Extract Production Inputs
nodes.notes: Extracts topic, product, script, visuals, voiceover, subtitles, SRT, and publishing data without changing upstream content.

nodes.name: Build Canonical Scene Specifications
nodes.notes: Creates the model-independent Canonical Scene Specification consumed by every video model adapter.

nodes.name: Generate Canonical Cinematic Prompts
nodes.notes: Creates one provider-neutral high-quality cinematic prompt per canonical scene.

nodes.name: Model Adapter Layer
nodes.notes: Normalizes provider selection and routes canonical scenes to an isolated model-specific adapter.

nodes.name: Use Veo 3 Adapter?
nodes.notes: TRUE selects Veo 3. FALSE checks the next installed model adapter.

nodes.name: Veo 3 Adapter
nodes.notes: Translates canonical scenes into Veo 3 prompt format only; no upstream fields depend on Veo 3.

nodes.name: Use Runway Adapter?
nodes.notes: TRUE selects Runway. FALSE checks the next installed model adapter.

nodes.name: Runway Adapter
nodes.notes: Translates canonical scenes into Runway prompt format only.

nodes.name: Use Kling Adapter?
nodes.notes: TRUE selects Kling. FALSE checks the next installed model adapter.

nodes.name: Kling Adapter
nodes.notes: Translates canonical scenes into Kling prompt format only.

nodes.name: Use Hailuo Adapter?
nodes.notes: TRUE selects Hailuo. FALSE returns an unsupported-adapter error.

nodes.name: Hailuo Adapter
nodes.notes: Translates canonical scenes into Hailuo prompt format only.

nodes.name: Build Model Adapter Error
nodes.notes: Stops safely when the requested provider has no installed adapter and lists supported choices.

nodes.name: Generate Image Prompts
nodes.notes: Builds optional model-independent reference-image prompts while preserving scene alignment.

nodes.name: Production Package QA
nodes.notes: Checks scene coverage, adapter output, voiceover, SRT, publishing data, and file readiness.

nodes.name: Production QA Passed?
nodes.notes: TRUE builds exports. FALSE returns a structured production QA error.

nodes.name: Build Production Error
nodes.notes: Returns QA issues and diagnostic counts without generating files.

nodes.name: Build Complete Production Package
nodes.notes: Assembles canonical scenes, selected adapter prompts, image prompts, voiceover, subtitles, publishing package, and QA.

nodes.name: Export Production Files
nodes.notes: Creates video_prompts.json, image_prompts.json, voiceover.txt, subtitles.srt, and production_package.md in memory.

nodes.name: AI Health OS Video Generator Output
nodes.notes: Returns the successful package summary and all five downloadable binary artifacts to the caller.

nodes.name: AI Health OS Video Generator Error Output
nodes.notes: Provides one consistent terminal error response for every failure path.

nodes.name: Prepare Runway API Request
nodes.notes: Creates one sanitized Runway text-to-video request per scene. Requires the n8n environment variable RUNWAY_API_KEY. TODO: verify endpoint, API version, model, ratio, duration, and field names against current Runway docs.

nodes.name: Submit Runway Generation Job
nodes.notes: Submits one Runway generation task per scene using Authorization: Bearer {{$env.RUNWAY_API_KEY}}. Built-in retries cover transient network/rate-limit failures. TODO: verify POST endpoint and headers against current Runway docs.

nodes.name: Capture Runway Job ID
nodes.notes: Captures the returned Runway task ID and restores scene_id without exposing authorization data. TODO: verify response ID and error fields.

nodes.name: Runway Submission Accepted?
nodes.notes: TRUE begins bounded polling. FALSE records a sanitized scene-level submission failure.

nodes.name: Build Runway Submission Failure
nodes.notes: Builds a structured submission failure for this scene, including rate-limit status but excluding credentials.

nodes.name: Wait for Runway Job
nodes.notes: Waits for the configurable poll_interval_seconds before checking task status. This node does not perform busy waiting.

nodes.name: Prepare Runway Status Request
nodes.notes: Builds the task-status URL from the preserved job ID. TODO: verify the task endpoint against current Runway docs.

nodes.name: Check Runway Job Status
nodes.notes: Checks one Runway task using RUNWAY_API_KEY. Includes retries, request timeout, full response status, and safe continuation for structured errors. TODO: verify GET endpoint and headers.

nodes.name: Normalize Runway Job Status
nodes.notes: Normalizes processing, success, failure, rate-limit, output URL, and metadata fields. TODO: verify task status values and output URL schema.

nodes.name: Runway Job Completed?
nodes.notes: TRUE collects the generated URL. FALSE checks terminal failure and then bounded polling limits.

nodes.name: Collect Runway Video URL
nodes.notes: Collects the generated video URL with scene_id, job ID, model, ratio, duration, polling count, and safe task metadata.

nodes.name: Runway Job Failed?
nodes.notes: TRUE records a terminal API/task failure. FALSE increments the bounded polling counter.

nodes.name: Build Runway API Failure
nodes.notes: Builds a sanitized scene-level task failure and retains the job ID for investigation.

nodes.name: Increment Runway Poll Count
nodes.notes: Increments poll_count and calculates elapsed time to prevent infinite polling.

nodes.name: Runway Poll Limit Reached?
nodes.notes: TRUE returns a timeout result. FALSE loops back to Wait for Runway Job.

nodes.name: Build Runway Timeout
nodes.notes: Builds a deterministic timeout result when max_poll_count or max_total_wait_seconds is reached.

nodes.name: Assemble Runway Scene Results
nodes.notes: Assembles every scene outcome in canonical order and succeeds only when all expected Runway jobs return video URLs.

nodes.name: Runway Execution Successful?
nodes.notes: TRUE rejoins the existing production path. FALSE routes to the existing unified error output through a structured Runway error.

nodes.name: Build Runway Execution Error
nodes.notes: Returns sanitized job metadata and scene failures without exposing RUNWAY_API_KEY or automatically publishing content.

nodes.name: Loop Over Runway Scenes
nodes.notes: Processes exactly one canonical scene at a time and emits all terminal scene results together after the loop, enabling deterministic final assembly.

nodes.name: Prepare Runway Submission Attempt
nodes.notes: Preserves scene_id and submit retry counters before the HTTP node so response normalization can restore the correct attempt state.

nodes.name: Runway Submission Retryable?
nodes.notes: TRUE retries HTTP 429, 5xx, or transport failures within the configured limit. FALSE records a terminal submission failure.

nodes.name: Increment Runway Submit Retry
nodes.notes: Increments the configurable submission retry counter without changing scene_id or request content.

nodes.name: Runway Submit Retries Exhausted?
nodes.notes: TRUE records a terminal failure. FALSE waits using Retry-After or the configured polling interval before resubmission.

nodes.name: Wait Before Runway Resubmit
nodes.notes: Honors a sanitized Retry-After value when available, otherwise uses poll_interval_seconds before a bounded resubmission attempt.
